purpose: Provide a matching single-process CPU exact-loop baseline for the XuanTie-E902 resident changing-input patch schedule gate.
preconditions: patch_script_lines use the same GLOBAL_OFF:BYTE, '-', and @repeat-seq grammar as the GPU resident gate

allowed_claims: single-process CPU repeated eval_step wall time with byte patch script application
GPU resident patch schedule throughput for XuanTie-E902 at the same bounded gate shape
CPU/GPU state-step throughput ratio for this specific non-TL-UL changing-input gate
non_claims: not proof of broad XuanTie family support
not a full RTL application throughput claim
CPU baseline applies byte patches directly to root storage and assumes global offsets match the GPU storage layout
byte patch offsets are validation stimuli and not XuanTie ISA/program semantics
